action.command:
for c in "norm-matching:normen_extraktion" "subsumtion-service:subsumtion" "risikohinweis-service:risikohinweis" "ki-guv-feedback:ki_guv_feedback" "dokumentensuche"; do
  img=${c%%:*}; mod=${c##*:}
  echo "=== $img ($mod) ==="
  timeout 60 docker run --rm --entrypoint sh "$img" -c "ls /app/.venv/bin/ | grep -iE '${mod%%_*}'; /app/.venv/bin/python -c 'import ${mod}; print(\"import ok\")' 2>&1 | tail -1"
done

tool_call.name: terminal
